classification: frozen secondary fault experiment; healthy acceptance gate passed; no calibration/test streams generated yet

model.kernel: local Metropolis plus exact centroid heat bath every sweep

primary_CI: CV BM512 on8192 postonset sweeps; intended finiteM target

channel_coupling.mapping: u_accept=u_proposal (both margins uniform; joint law altered)

fault_scope: offline experimental adapter; source role identified; no physical data or live instruments used
pairing: healthy/fault conditions reuse initial/update/centroid/scan seeds within a replica; independent replica indices and disjoint cal/test/healthy-confirm namespaces

monitors.source_marginal: max absolute deviation of proposal or acceptance window mean from .5
monitors.application_shape: absolute window mean shape r_g² deviation from finiteM target
monitors.threshold: ceil((calibration_n+1)*.95)-th order statistic of entire-path max; strict > threshold; no retuning
monitors.healthy_validation_gate: each monitor CP95 upper false-alarm bound<=.10 on512 healthy test paths; report actual rates, not exact equal FPR
monitors.postonset_windows: classified by endpoint>=2049; earliest endpoint2304 spans1281-2304 and intentionally includes prefault data
monitors.multiple_monitors: 5% target is separate for each monitor, not a combined5% policy
monitors.paired_comparison: whole-run alert indicator fault minus healthy with replica bootstrap95; secondary descriptive

application_failure.meaning: prespecified numerical tolerance excursion, not a physical safety limit; distinct from calibrated anomaly monitor
application_failure.censoring: no event by10240 -> right censored; already failed before onset counted separately

primary_effects: paired postonset CV mean difference with t CI across replicas
paired intended-target coverage change with replica bootstrap95
no_superiority_rule: do not generalize application superiority; marginal-source and cross-channel monitors have different information; use paired comparisons and actual healthy false alarms
